domain_lemmas.rationale: This simplification asserts the binary-value invariant of loopDigits under a guarded domain; it does not define a fresh summary symbol, and every simplification rule must be classified as DEFINITION or DOMAIN_LEMMA.
domain_lemmas.text:
rule bitWeight(loopDigits(V, A)) +Int bitValue(loopDigits(V, A))
    => V *Int bitWeight(A) +Int bitValue(A)
    requires V >Int 0 andBool allBits(A)
    [simplification]

domain_lemmas.rationale: This simplification asserts that loopDigits preserves the allBits predicate on the guarded domain; it states a property of existing definitions rather than defining a summary or execution rule.

    requires V >Int 0 andBool allBits(A)

operational_rules.rationale: This priority rule consumes the exact translated while-loop and updates the active value and digits bindings, so its behavior is an execution transition in the verification model rather than a mathematical definition or fact.
operational_rules.text:
rule <k>
         #while(
           Compare(Name("value"), CmpOp(">", Int(1))),
           Assign(
             Name("digits"),
             BinOp(
               "+",
               Call(
                 Name("chr"),
                 BinOp("+", Int(48), BinOp("%", Name("value"), Int(2)))),
               Name("digits")))
           Assign(Name("value"), BinOp("//", Name("value"), Int(2))))
         => .K
         ...
       </k>
       <env> 1 </env>
       <scopes>
         -1 |-> BUILTINS:Scope
         0 |-> scope(MODULE:Map, parent(-1))
         1 |-> scope(
           "n" |-> NI:Int
           "m" |-> MI:Int
           "value" |-> (V:Int => 1)
           "digits" |-> (str(A:IntSeq) => str(loopDigits(V, A))),
           parent(0))
       </scopes>
    requires V >Int 0
      andBool allBits(A)
      andBool BUILTINS ==K builtinsScope
      andBool notBool ("chr" in_keys(MODULE))
    [priority(40)]
